passages.text: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
passages.sermon:
Aaron had four sons.
Their names were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
These sons became the ancestors of different groups.
Each group came from one of Aaron’s sons.
These groups were called the divisions of the descendants of Aaron.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

passages.text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
passages.sermon:
Nadab and Abihu were sons of Aaron.
Nadab and Abihu died before their father Aaron.
Nadab and Abihu had no sons.
Eleazar and Ithamar were also sons of Aaron.
Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨מָת נָדָ֤ב וַאֲבִיהוּא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַֽיְכַהֲנ֔וּ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

passages.text: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech, David divided them according to the offices of their service.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
Zadok was a descendant of Eleazar.
Ahimelech was a descendant of Ithamar.
David divided the priests into groups.
Zadok helped David.
Ahimelech also helped David.
They divided the priests by their assigned duties.
Each group received its office of service.
passages.original: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וְצָדוֹק֙ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַאֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר לִפְקֻדָּתָ֖ם בַּעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃

passages.text: Since more leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than those of Ithamar, they were divided accordingly. There were sixteen heads of families from the descendants of Eleazar and eight from the descendants of Ithamar.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar and Ithamar were both sons of Aaron.
Eleazar’s descendants had more leaders than Ithamar’s descendants.
They divided the families based on this difference.
There were sixteen heads of families among Eleazar’s descendants.
There were eight heads of families among Ithamar’s descendants.
passages.original: וַיִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי־ אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽיַּחְלְק֑וּם לִבְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־ אָבוֹת֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר וְלִבְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם שְׁמוֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: Thus they were divided by lot, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s and Ithamar’s descendants.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
\r\nZadok was a descendant of Eleazar.
\r\nAhimelech was a descendant of Ithamar.
\r\nDavid divided the priests into groups.
\r\nHe used lots to decide the order.
\r\nBoth Eleazar’s descendants and Ithamar’s descendants had leaders.
\r\nSome leaders were officers of the sanctuary.
\r\nSome leaders were officers of God.
\r\nThese officers came from both Eleazar’s family and Ithamar’s family.
passages.original: וַיַּחְלְק֥וּם בְּגוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־ הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּבִבְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר׃ס

passages.text: The scribe, Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officers: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar, and then one from Ithamar.
passages.sermon:
Shemaiah was a scribe.
He was the son of Nethanel.
Shemaiah was a Levite.
Shemaiah wrote down their names.
He did this in front of the king.
He did this in front of the officers.
Zadok was present.
Zadok was the priest.
Ahimelech was present.
Ahimelech was the son of Abiathar.
The heads of families of the priests were present.
The heads of families of the Levites were present.
They chose one family from Eleazar.
They chose one family from Ithamar.
They took turns choosing families from Eleazar and from Ithamar.
passages.original: וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֡ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן־ נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַסּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן־ הַלֵּוִ֗י לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ וְצָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וַאֲחִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם בֵּֽית־ אָ֣ב אֶחָ֗ד אָחֻז֙ לְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְאָחֻ֥ז׀ אָחֻ֖ז לְאִיתָמָֽר׃פ

passages.text: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah, the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim, the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin, the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah, the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah, the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim, the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab, the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer, the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez, the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel, the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul, the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
passages.sermon:
The priests and Levites were divided into groups by casting lots.
Each group received its order for service in the house of the Lord.
The first lot went to Jehoiarib.
The second lot went to Jedaiah.
The third lot went to Harim.
The fourth lot went to Seorim.
The fifth lot went to Malchijah.
The sixth lot went to Mijamin.
The seventh lot went to Hakkoz.
The eighth lot went to Abijah.
The ninth lot went to Jeshua.
The tenth lot went to Shecaniah.
The eleventh lot went to Eliashib.
The twelfth lot went to Jakim.
The thirteenth lot went to Huppah.
The fourteenth lot went to Jeshebeab.
The fifteenth lot went to Bilgah.
The sixteenth lot went to Immer.
The seventeenth lot went to Hezir.
The eighteenth lot went to Happizzez.
The nineteenth lot went to Pethahiah.
The twentieth lot went to Jehezkel.
The twenty-first lot went to Jachin.
The twenty-second lot went to Gamul.
The twenty-third lot went to Delaiah.
The twenty-fourth lot went to Maaziah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ לִיה֣וֹיָרִ֔יב לִֽידַעְיָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃ לְחָרִם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִשְׂעֹרִ֖ים הָרְבִעִֽי׃ לְמַלְכִּיָּה֙ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמִיָּמִ֖ן הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃ לְהַקּוֹץ֙ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה הַשְּׁמִינִֽי׃ לְיֵשׁ֙וּעַ֙ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י לִשְׁכַנְיָ֖הוּ הָעֲשִׂרִֽי׃ לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר לְיָקִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ לְחֻפָּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְיֶֽשֶׁבְאָ֖ב אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ לְבִלְגָּה֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְאִמֵּ֖ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ לְחֵזִיר֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְהַפִּצֵּ֖ץ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ לִֽפְתַחְיָה֙ תִּשְׁעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לִֽיחֶזְקֵ֖אל הָעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ לְיָכִין֙ אֶחָ֣ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְגָמ֖וּל שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ לִדְלָיָ֙הוּ֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְמַֽעַזְיָ֖הוּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃פ

passages.text: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave commands to Aaron.
Aaron was the forefather of the priests.
Aaron gave regulations for service in the house of the LORD.
The priests followed these regulations.
Each priest had an appointed order for service.
The priests entered the house of the LORD in this order.
They served according to the commands of the LORD.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞ם לַעֲבֹדָתָ֗ם לָב֤וֹא לְבֵית־ יְהוָה֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔הוּ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Now these were the remaining descendants of Levi: From the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Levi had remaining descendants.
One group came from the sons of Amram.
Shubael was a son of Amram.
Jehdeiah was a son of Shubael.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים לִבְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִבְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: The first was Isshiah.
passages.sermon: Rehabiah was a descendant of Levi.\r\nRehabiah had sons.\r\nThe first son of Rehabiah was Isshiah.
passages.original: לִרְחַבְיָ֑הוּ לִבְנֵ֣י רְחַבְיָ֔הוּ הָרֹ֖אשׁ יִשִּׁיָּֽה׃

passages.text: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
passages.sermon: The Izharites are descendants of Levi.\r\nShelomoth is one of the Izharites.\r\nJahath is a son of Shelomoth.
passages.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֣י שְׁלֹמ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י שְׁלֹמ֖וֹת יָֽחַת׃

passages.text: From the sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
passages.sermon:
Hebron had sons.
Jeriah was the first son of Hebron.
Amariah was the second son of Hebron.
Jahaziel was the third son of Hebron.
Jekameam was the fourth son of Hebron.
passages.original: וּבְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

passages.text: From the sons of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
passages.sermon:
Uzziel had sons.
One son was Micah.
Micah had sons.
One son was Shamir.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה שָׁמוּר׃

passages.text: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; from the sons of Isshiah: Zechariah.
passages.sermon: Isshiah was the brother of Micah.\r\nZechariah was a son of Isshiah.
passages.original: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
passages.sermon:
Merari had two sons.
Their names were Mahli and Mushi.
Jaaziah had a son.
His name was Beno.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Merari from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
passages.sermon:
Merari was a Levite.
Merari had descendants.
Jaaziah was one of Merari’s descendants.
Jaaziah had sons.
Their names were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְיַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנ֔וֹ וְשֹׁ֥הַם וְזַכּ֖וּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃

passages.text: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
passages.sermon: Mahli was a descendant of Merari.\r\nMahli had a son named Eleazar.\r\nEleazar did not have any sons.
passages.original: לְמַחְלִי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בָּנִֽים׃

passages.text: From Kish: Jerahmeel the son of Kish.
passages.sermon: Kish was a Levite.\r\nJerahmeel was the son of Kish.\r\nJerahmeel belonged to the family of Kish.
passages.original: לְקִ֖ישׁ בְּנֵי־ קִ֥ישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites, according to their families.
passages.sermon:
Mushi was a Levite.
Mushi had three sons.
Their names were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth.
These men were sons of the Levites.
They belonged to their own family groups.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֖דֶר וִירִימ֑וֹת אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
passages.sermon:
The Levites cast lots.
The descendants of Aaron were their brothers.
The Levites did this just as the descendants of Aaron did.
They cast lots in front of King David.
Zadok was present.
Ahimelech was present.
The heads of the families of the priests were present.
The heads of the families of the Levites were present.
Both the family leaders and their younger brothers were there.
passages.original: וַיַּפִּילוּ֩ גַם־ הֵ֨ם גּוֹרָל֜וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן לִפְנֵ֨י דָוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְצָד֣וֹק וַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אָב֣וֹת הָרֹ֔אשׁ לְעֻמַּ֖ת אָחִ֥יו הַקָּטָֽן׃ס
